# BONE MARROW POST-TRANSPLANT VACCINATION

Seasonal influenza vaccination should be administered yearly. Patient should be

administered COVID-19 vaccinations to be up-to-date per current CDC guidelines.

Influenza and COVID-19 vaccinations may be administered via nursing standing

orders.

Order sets are available below for other post-transplant vaccine regimens.

Choose vaccine regimen based on location where transplant was performed and

type of transplantation.
